scope: Computational control using the same single published specimen and seed. Five unmodified C-alpha rows were selected from the deposited coordinates before this Run. This excerpt is an explicitly constructed control, not a second deposition.
decision_criterion: Withhold any whole-molecule agreement conclusion when >50% of preregistered mapped positions lack comparable C-alpha coordinates; a local discrepancy may still be reported.
method: Scientific criterion frozen for evaluation outside the Lead question. Lead must read its own Job output.
